known_secrets.text: I have identified at least three recurring migration loops that do not match seasonal logic.
These loops sometimes intersect near old unused paths leading toward higher terraces.
Animal routes occasionally form near-perfect geometric patterns when mapped over time.
This is extremely rare and not explained in current village knowledge.
I have shared partial observations with Roka.
We do not fully agree on interpretation.
Certain prey species avoid stone-marked ground more strongly than predators do.
This behavior is inconsistent with known ecological logic.
I have not reported this formally.
